nodes.label: Chart Color Zones Fix (2026-09-11)
nodes.description: Fix for chart semantic zone colors. Backend projects zones from RuleToGraphZones; frontend paints with SINOA tokens. Demo server lacked bands for sensors; buildZonesViewModel converted absence to neutral gray. Added explicit synthetic intervals to demo server (not modifying backend rules/data). Chart now reserves margin outside configured limits to show outer bands. CacheDir separated by mode to avoid Vite 504 collisions. Verification: 34 tests correct (zoneBackgroundPlugin, graphZonesProjection, chartTheme, SensorReadingChart); Chrome headless checks 100+ pixels per canvas at 1440 and 390px.
nodes.rationale: Documents the chart zone color implementation and verification. Shows the integration between RuleToGraphZones (backend), buildZonesViewModel (frontend), and SINOA token system.
